question: Which of the following is a form of renewable energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Solar Energy**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Solar energy** is a form of renewable energy
 
• Solar energy **is a renewable energy source because it comes from the sun and is constantly replenished**.
 
• It's also the most abundant energy resource and can be used even on cloudy days.
 
• A **type of radiant energy, or electromagnetic radiation, that can be harnessed to generate electrici**ty.
 
• Solar energy is clean and doesn't create greenhouse gases or require mining or drilling

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Energy Type

 Examples

 Potential Energy

 Fuels (e.g., gasoline, food), Batteries, Biomass
